snippet.title: Red Echoes: Berlin - Game Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Berlin 1918. Amidst the turmoil of the Great War, the fires of revolution burn. With the German Kaiser's reign rapidly coming to an end, lead a group of socialist revolutionaries and attempt to change the course of history. Will you succeed and bring about a better tomorrow?

Wishlist On Steam!
